description: This Java source file defines the CtrTransportCipher class, which implements encryption and decryption for network communication using AES/CTR/NoPadding mode. It includes inner classes for handling encryption/decryption channels and message streaming, integrating with Netty pipeline handlers.

classes.name: CtrTransportCipher
classes.description: Main class implementing network encryption/decryption using AES in CTR mode, with methods to create crypto streams and add handlers to Netty channels.

classes.name: CtrTransportCipher.EncryptionHandler
classes.description: Netty outbound handler for encrypting outgoing messages.

classes.name: CtrTransportCipher.DecryptionHandler
classes.description: Netty inbound handler for decrypting incoming messages.

classes.name: CtrTransportCipher.EncryptedMessage
classes.description: Represents an encrypted message as a streamable file region, handling encryption of data chunks.

methods.name: getKeyId
methods.description: Returns the key identifier for the encryption key.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the SecretKeySpec used for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: getInputIv
methods.description: Returns the IV for input channel.

methods.name: getOutputIv
methods.description: Returns the IV for output channel.

methods.name: createOutputStream
methods.description: Creates a CryptoOutputStream for encrypting data.

methods.name: createInputStream
methods.description: Creates a CryptoInputStream for decrypting data.

methods.name: addToChannel
methods.description: Adds encryption and decryption handlers to a Netty channel pipeline.
